$comment: Schema for the shell chrome's sign_in action. Self-contained and closed: re-declares every property action.v1 would otherwise provide and rejects any undeclared field, on itself and on its own payload.

type.$comment: Self-reference to this action's schema type ID

target.$comment: The popup domain, the modal extension domain this shell implements (mfe/modalDomain.ts): it registers the sign_in handler, so a chain aimed at the screen, sidebar or overlay is refused here instead of two layers later as a missing handler

payload.$comment: Closed and empty: sign_in carries no credentials. The sign-in extension signs in through the shared auth runtime (auth() with no provider), never through an action payload; the action only holds the chain open until a session exists

timeout.$comment: Optional timeout override in milliseconds. sign_in is expected to carry its own long timeout (the chain builder in app/auth/signIn.ts decides it), since the action spans a user typing credentials
